title: Dr. Wilhelm Filchner Actually Arrived In Shanghai By The

page_data.en:
December 6 34.

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to your letter dated
December 4, 1934, I have to state that Dr.
Wilhelm Filchner arrived in Shanghai from
Bombay on board the S.S. "Conte Rosso" on
November 5, 1934. Shortly after his arrival
Filchner left for Nanking and is still there
at present. His address is unknown, but according
to enquiries made, mail matter addressed c/o German
Consulate-General, Nanking, will reach him.

Yours sincerely,

H. N. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.
page_data.zh:
1934年12月6日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

关于您1934年12月4日的来信，兹说明如下：威廉·菲尔希纳（Wilhelm Filchner）博士于1934年11月5日乘“罗索伯爵”号（S.S. "Conte Rosso"）轮船从孟买抵达上海。抵沪后不久，菲尔希纳即前往南京，目前仍在该地。其具体地址不详，但据查询，寄往南京德国总领事馆转交的信函可送达其本人。

此致

敬礼

H. N. 斯蒂普托（H. N. Steptoe）先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

Fm. 2
G. 35080-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......

REPORT    Special Branch Station,
          Date December 6, 1934.

Subject (in full) Communication dated December 4, 1934 from H.B.M. Consulate-
General relating to Dr. Wilhelm FILCHNER.

Made by D.S. Pitts.    Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

In compliance with the instructions of the
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch) appearing on the
attached copy of a communication dated December 4, 1934
from H.B.M. Consulate-General, I have to state that Dr.
Wilhelm FILCHNER arrived in Shanghai on November 5, 1934
from Bombay as a first-class passenger on board the s.s.
"Conte Rosso."

He left shortly afterwards for Nanking where
he is at present. His address in Nanking is unknown, but
according to enquiries made, mail matter forwarded to the
German Consulate-General, Nanking will find the gentleman.

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

发自 2
G. 35080-1-34

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ____ 

报告    特别分部警署，
          日期 1934年12月6日。

主题（全称） 英国驻上海总领事馆1934年12月4日关于威廉·菲尔希纳（Wilhelm FILCHNER）博士的来函。

撰写人：D.S. 皮茨（Pitts）。    转发人：〔此处转录不清〕

遵照附呈的英国驻上海总领事馆1934年12月4日来函副本上所载副警务处长（特别分部）的指示，兹说明如下：威廉·菲尔希纳（Wilhelm FILCHNER）博士于1934年11月5日作为头等舱乘客，乘“罗索伯爵”号（s.s. "Conte Rosso"）轮船从孟买抵达上海。

此后不久他即前往南京，目前仍在该地。其在南京的地址不详，但据查询，寄往南京德国总领事馆转交的邮件可送达该人士。

D.S. 皮茨（Pitts）。
D. S.

副警务处长（特别分部）。

page_data.en:
December 4, 1934.

My dear Givens,

I shall be grateful if you could find out
for me whether or not DR. WILHELM FILCHNER actually
arrived in Shanghai by the s.s. "Conte Rosso" which
left Bombay on the 24th October 1934.

Filchner is a very well known scientist and
explorer who in 1927 earned considerable fame by
his very arduous journey from West China to Leh,
during which journey he made certain observations
in connection with terrestrial magnetism, his researches
in connection with this being finally completed at an
Indian station called Dehradun. I understand that
Filchner most probably will go to North West China in
and I wish to see him before he leaves.
the near future, In order to make arrangements to
this end I must know whether or not Filchner did actually
come by the "Conte Rosso".

Yours sincerely
(H.N. Steptoe)

S2,
For discreet inquiry
and report please. Avoid
asking assistance of
German Authorities.
J.K.S.
DEC 5 1934
D.S. 7/12. DAR 5/12
page_data.zh:
1934年12月4日。

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

如蒙查明威廉·菲尔希纳（DR. WILHELM FILCHNER）博士是否确实乘坐1934年10月24日从孟买开出的“罗索伯爵”号（s.s. "Conte Rosso"）轮船抵达上海，我将不胜感激。

菲尔希纳是一位著名的科学家和探险家，1927年因完成从华西到列城（Leh）的艰苦旅程而赢得巨大声誉，在该次旅程中，他就地磁方面进行了一些观测，相关研究最终在印度一个叫德拉敦（Dehradun）的站点完成。据悉，菲尔希纳很可能在不久的将来前往中国西北，我希望在他离开前与其会面。为此目的，我必须确知菲尔希纳是否确实乘坐“罗索伯爵”号前来。

此致

敬礼

(H.N. 斯蒂普托（Steptoe）)

S2，
请进行谨慎调查
并具报。避免
寻求德国当局
协助。
J.K.S.
1934年12月5日
D.S. 12/7. DAR 12/5
